sourceText:
Ultimate Healthy Xocai Chip Cookies
By: Adam Paul Green
Published: Tuesday, May 22, 2012 - 11:05pm

Ingredients




1 cup peanut butter
1/4 cup butter
1/2 cup vanilla yogurt
2/3 cup brown sugar
2/3 cup granulated sugar
2 whole eggs
1 tsp vanilla extract
2 cups quick oats
1 cup whole wheat flour
1 tsp baking powder
1 tsp baking soda
1/2 tsp salt
1/2 cup dried cranberries
10 Xocai Healthy Chocolate Nuggets, coarsely chopped

Preparation

1 At medium speed in a large bowl, beat together first 5 ingredients. Then add and beat in eggs and vanilla. In a separate bowl, combine remaining ingredients; add to wet mixture. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet and bake at 350 degrees for 8 to 12 minutes. Makes 36 cookies
